regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: 2000-PENALTY correctly implements the 7-day/₹500 calculation, but it only executes when 88-level PENALTY-ON is true (line 20). WS-PEN-ENABLED is declared VALUE 'N' (line 10, PENALTY-ON = 'Y' only) and no statement anywhere in this program ever moves 'Y' into WS-PEN-ENABLED -- the only ACCEPT in the program (line 19) reads WS-ELAPSED-DAYS, not the flag. Under the program's own reachable control flow from its true entry, PERFORM 2000-PENALTY is therefore never actually taken.
